historicalTreatment.rule: Bets placed before the effective timestamp retain the unit value and stakeUnits used at placement. Future ledger entries must include unitValueVndAtPlacement so results across unit regimes remain auditable.

ledgerRequirements: Record unitValueVndAtPlacement on every new bet.
Report actual VND profit and loss independently from normalized model stake performance.
Do not rewrite historical VND amounts or historical unit labels solely because the active unit value changed.
notes: User reaffirmed the active default unit on 2026-08-02: 1u = 1,000,000 VND. Therefore 0.25u = 250,000 VND and 0.5u = 500,000 VND.
